title: Patient services desk guide: straight-tip catheter refills on the Continence Original Medicare Program
content:
On the Urology and Continence Supply Program, a customer on the Continence Original Medicare Program may ask for a refill of straight-tip intermittent catheters (A4351). This policy settles the billing units of that refill, which is released as one package by standard ground shipping and billed to Medicare by claim.

## Conditions that govern the release

- The refill's units are fixed only after the posting named on the program's newest approved hardship application carries its hardship waiver adjustment.
- Every eligibility of the base refill, quantity, consolidation, exclusion, liability-notice and patient-account rules stays in force for this refill.

## Releasing the refill: `ship_catheter_refill_863073b5`

**Capability.** The tool releases one refill package of straight-tip intermittent catheters (HCPCS A4351) on a customer's Urology and Continence Supply Program. One call records one package leaving the warehouse today by standard ground shipping, billed to the program's payer by claim. It draws the given billing units from the named authorization grant, and the program's billing units still authorized to ship fall by the units shipped. Today's date is recorded as the customer's refill confirmation date. The customer can then be told the package is on its way.

**How it is invoked.** This is an agent-side tool. The agent unlocks `ship_catheter_refill_863073b5` and then calls it.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `customer_id` | the customer reference number of the program holder, read from the customer profile lookup; the package is addressed to this customer | identifier |
| `continence_program_id` | the reference number of the customer's Urology and Continence Supply Program the refill ships on, read from the program lookup | identifier |
| `coverage_id` | the reference number of the insurance coverage record the program bills, read from the program lookup; it is part of the package's reference | identifier |
| `continence_order_id` | the reference number of the authorization grant record the refill draws its units from, read from the program's prescription and authorization file lookup | identifier |
| `previous_continence_shipment_id` | the reference number of the program's latest earlier refill package of the same catheter, read from the shipment history lookup; it is part of the new package's reference | identifier |
| `units` | the billing units of straight-tip catheters in the package; one billing unit is one catheter, so the package also holds that count of physical pieces | whole number, no decimals |
| `supply_days` | the days of supply the package covers | whole calendar days, a multiple of 30 |

**Return.** On success the tool returns a receipt with:

- `status` "shipped";
- `continence_shipment_id`, the new shipment reference;
- `item_code`, always A4351;
- `units` and `supply_days`, as shipped;
- `ship_date`, today in the form YYYY-MM-DD;
- `authorized_units_remaining`, the whole billing units still authorized after this package.

## Illustration of a receipt (hypothetical values)

A call with 480 units and 90 supply days on a program that had 1,200 units authorized returns status "shipped", units 480, supply days 90 and 720 units remaining.
